prompt: rgb.jpg is a horizontal strip of 5 frames, left to right in time order, sampled from the few seconds of a head-mounted (egocentric) video; the camera wearer is the viewpoint. Describe the spatial understanding this image supports: the layout of the scene; which people and objects are present and roughly how far each is from the camera wearer (in metres) and from each other; relative positions (left/right/in front/behind, above/below); which way people face and whether they look toward the camera wearer; what is within arm's reach of the camera wearer or of others; occlusions and anything partly out of view; and how these change across the 5 frames (approach, retreat, turning). Describe only spatial facts. Do not guess anyone's intentions, social norms, or what anyone should do. Return only JSON: {"rgb": "..."} with 4-6 sentences.

descriptions.rgb: A broad, mostly level grassy field extends ahead beneath an overcast sky, with a line of trees and shrubs roughly 25–60 m away along the horizon and no nearby objects behind the camera visible. One person remains in front of the camera wearer, slightly right of center, approaching from roughly 15–20 m in frame 1 to about 1–2 m by frame 5; they face generally toward the camera and appear to look toward it in the later frames. A second, much smaller person is intermittently visible farther ahead and to the right of the approaching person, approximately 15–30 m from the camera and roughly 10–20 m from the nearer person. The nearer person grows progressively larger while shifting toward the right edge, with their body turning slightly sideways by the final frame; in frame 5 their right side is cut off by the image boundary. Nothing is clearly within the camera wearer’s arm’s reach until possibly the final frame, when the nearer person is at approximately arm’s-length range, while the distant person and all trees remain well beyond reach. The people do not substantially occlude the field or trees, although the nearer person partly blocks a small area of grass and horizon as they approach.
